# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    return -float(node.id)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    m = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        s = ctx.graph.src[e]
        d = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if s == pod.id:
            other = d
        elif d == pod.id:
            other = s
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                total += ctx.graph.rate[e] * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
    cpu_ratio = 0.0
    if node.cpu_capacity > 0:
        cpu_ratio = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_ratio = 0.0
    if node.mem_capacity > 0:
        mem_ratio = float(node.mem_allocated) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    val = 0.0
    val -= total * 0.5
    val += cpu_ratio * 280.0
    val += mem_ratio * 70.0
    if node.suspended:
        val -= 1000.0
    return val

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    target_nodes: list[int] = []
    target_cpu: list[int] = []
    target_mem: list[int] = []
    n = len(state.pods)
    for i in range(n):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        pod = state.pods[i]
        cur = pod.current_node
        eligible = cur >= 0 and not pod.stateful and not pod.has_pdb
        if eligible:
            cur_node = state.nodes[cur]
            low_util = cur_node.cpu_capacity > 0 and cur_node.cpu_allocated * 2 < cur_node.cpu_capacity
            if low_util and not cur_node.suspended:
                best = -1
                best_score = -1000000.0
                nn = len(state.nodes)
                for j in range(nn):
                    node = state.nodes[j]
                    used_cpu = 0
                    used_mem = 0
                    for k in range(len(target_nodes)):
                        if target_nodes[k] == j:
                            used_cpu += target_cpu[k]
                            used_mem += target_mem[k]
                    fits = j != cur
                    fits = fits and not node.suspended
                    fits = fits and node.cpu_capacity > 0
                    fits = fits and node.cpu_allocated + used_cpu + pod.cpu_request <= node.cpu_capacity
                    fits = fits and node.mem_allocated + used_mem + pod.mem_request <= node.mem_capacity
                    if fits:
                        new_cpu = node.cpu_allocated + used_cpu + pod.cpu_request
                        cpu_ratio = float(new_cpu) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
                        score_val = cpu_ratio * 500.0
                        if score_val > best_score:
                            best_score = score_val
                            best = j
                if best >= 0:
                    src_ratio = float(cur_node.cpu_allocated) / float(cur_node.cpu_capacity)
                    if best_score > src_ratio * 500.0:
                        out.append(move_pod(pod.id, best))
                        target_nodes.append(best)
                        target_cpu.append(pod.cpu_request)
                        target_mem.append(pod.mem_request)
                        moved += 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
